On integral short curves h*g is a square for every rational point in the patch. At p not dividing 6 alpha beta, v_p(g)=min(v_p(q),2v_p(qprime))-v_p(h), using the reciprocal chart at infinity. Fixed exceptional primes remain outside the derivative shortcut. No C/L optimization, target-based policy tuning, new points or additional CPU arms.
